Build a survival model formula from variable names

Source: R/survival_utils.R
dot-buildSurvivalFormula.Rd

Consolidated helper used across the survival-analysis backends (e.g. multisurvival.b.R) to assemble a survival::Surv(...) ~ ... formula from raw variable names, with safe escaping of non-syntactic names via .escapeVariableNames() and safe parsing via .asSurvivalFormula().

Usage

.buildSurvivalFormula(
  time_var,
  outcome_var,
  predictors,
  survival_type = "standard",
  start_var = NULL,
  stop_var = NULL,
  strata_vars = NULL,
  interaction_terms = NULL
)

Arguments

time_var

Character. Time variable name (or start time for "standard"/"interval" types).

outcome_var

Character. Event/outcome variable name.

predictors

Character vector of predictor (main-effect) variable names.

survival_type

One of "standard", "counting", "interval".

start_var

Character. Start-time variable name (required when survival_type = "counting").

stop_var

Character. Stop-time variable name (required when survival_type is "counting" or "interval").

strata_vars

Character vector of stratification variable names.

interaction_terms

Character vector of already-escaped, :-joined interaction terms (e.g. "`Arm`:`Bio`") appended to the right-hand side after main effects and before strata.

Value

A parsed formula object (see .asSurvivalFormula()).
